translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: An u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic hebreo

content: A Dios tu jilchamalitshue i bijchith cau abal qui ejtou cu otsits cu coyots c’al jaja’. Expith qui lej t’aja’ ti cuenta qui bela’ a Dios, cum max i qui bela’ yab ne’ets cu coyots c’al jaja’.
Jant’ini’ ti olchinenec an Israelchic ti jayq’ui’ i alhua’ cau, antsana’ xo’ u olchinalhue. Tocat jahua’ olchinenecchic jolat, cum yab im belchi. Expith in ats’a’q’uichic.
Expith huahua’ ax i belal a Dios ojni’ u otsel cu coyots c’al jaja’. Tin cuenta axi ti jayq’ui’ yab im belamal, in ulu a Dios antse’:

content.text: In tsacucun c’al an Israelchic ani u cuba’ tu ba’ tin lej chubax c’al u cahuintal c’al jaja’chic abal yab ne’ets cu jila’ ca otsits ca coyots c’al nana’ ti al an tsabal jun tu bijchamalits.

content: Antsana’ in ulu a Dios aba ani’ in q’uejab tsalpayamalits tam ti yabaye ts’ejcanenec an eb ani an tsabal abal ne’ets quin jila’chic ca otsits.

In co’oyits ts’ejcacath abal ca coyotschic jant’ini’ jaja’ coyots. In olnal an T’ocat Thuchlab in cahuintal a Dios jahua’ in t’aja’ a Dios tam tim bajuhuits am bucchilab q’uicha semana tam tin tala’ ts’ejcamalits an eb ani an tsabal. In ulal:

content.text: Ti bucchilab q’uicha coyots a Dios, cum in tala’ ts’ejcamalits an eb ani an tsabal ani patal jant’o hua’ats.

content: Bel yab jilanchic ca coyots an Israel. In ulu a Dios ti al an T’ocat Thuchlab:

content.text: Yab ne’ets cu jila’chic ca otsits ca coyots c’al nana’.

content: Tin ebal in jec’omtal jats ti yab otsenec axi c’a’alchic olchinenec nixe’ xi alhua’ cau. Aba ani’ yab otsits jaja’chic, bel hua’ats jita’chic xo’ ax u otsel.

Cum talbel a Dios im bijiyamalits junaque i q’uij tam an inicchic ca otsits c’al jaja’ ca coyots. Ja’its axi xo’ an q’uij q’uicha axi a Dios in olna’ tam tin cahuintha’ a David. Axi c’a’al olchinenecchic yab otsits ani yan i tamub talbel a Dios in cahuintha’ a David ani thuchathits jaye ti al an T’ocat Thuchlab antse’:

content.text: Xo’ ojni’ in le’ ti tauna’chic a Dios.
Yab ca t’aja’ t’ujbabathchic a ichich.

content: Max ja’ac nixe’ an coytalab ax in exla’ talbel an Israelchic c’al a Josué jayetseq’ui ejtil axi xo’ hua’ats c’al a Dios, a Dios yab in ulumalac hua’ats junaque i coytalab.
Xo’ huahua’ tu bichohuil a Dios i ejtohual cu otsits ani cu jum putat coyots c’al a Dios.

Jant’ini’ ti coyots a Dios tam tin tala’ ts’ejcamalits an eb ani an tsabal ani patal jahua’ hua’ats ani yabats in ts’ejca’ jant’o, antsana’ jitats ca otsits ani ca coyots c’al a Dios yabats in yejenchal quin ts’ejcachiquiy jant’o abal ca otsits c’al jaja’. Patal ts’ejcacathits a Dios in cua’al.
Jaxtam in tomnal qui lej luba’ cu otsits ani cu coyots c’al a Dios, ani yab qui t’aja’ jant’ini’ jaja’chic axi yab otsenec ti jayq’ui’ cum yab im belamal a Dios.

In cahuintal a Dios tu lej ejatlinchal ani tu lej tsaplinchal i ichich. In hui’ith i cutsil axi tomchith hui’ith yab im bauchal in hui’ith in cahuintal a Dios. Cum u lej lo’ox in cahuintal a Dios, u otsel ma ti ejattal ani ti ichich lej luputh. U otsel ti ichich jun ti hua’ats i lej tsinat cau. Tu tala’ exlanchalits in tsalap i ichich ax i cua’al ts’ejcacathits ti ichich, ani ma jaye jahua’ yabaye i tsalpayamal ne’ets qui t’aja’.

Ni jant’o yab i ejtohual qui tsinc’onchi a Dios, cum tim patal jahua’ hua’ats u tala’ tsu’tab c’al jaja’. Ani ja’its c’al a Dios ne’ets qui bina’ i cuenta patal jahua’ i tsalpayamalits ani patal jahua’ i t’ajamalits teje’ tsabal.
A Jesús ja’its an lej ts’ale pale’
Cum a Jesús in Tsacamil a Dios axi lej ts’ale pale’ ti eb c’uajatits c’al a Dios, jaxtam qui junini’ palenchi ani qui junini’ olna’ in ey.
Cum ni jayq’ui’ yab hualbinenec tam ti nixoc’na le’na ca hualbin ejtil huahua’, jaxtam in lej huit’al tucu yajnanchi huahua’ lej palu ti ba’.
Jaxtam qui lej tsapna’ ani qui utenchi a Dios ti eb tin ts’alat coytal abal jaja’ tucu yajnanchi. Tihua’ cu c’uajiy qui ets’ey bats’u in alhua’ inictal c’al jahuaquits tam yejenchixtalab i cua’al.
